name: acme-sample
description: Gold set over data/corpus. Relevance is labelled per (document, page) so nDCG and recall measure whether the right *page* surfaced, not merely the right file. Three questions are deliberately unanswerable from the corpus; refusal accuracy scores whether the system declines exactly on those.

questions.question: How many days of annual leave do full-time employees get?
How many unused annual leave days can be carried into the next year, and by when must they be used?
When is a medical certificate required for sick leave?
How much paid parental leave does a secondary caregiver receive?
What is the scope of services under the master services agreement?
Is twenty-four-hour production support included in the scope?
What is the payment term for an undisputed invoice?
How much notice is required to terminate the agreement for convenience?
How is the supplier's aggregate liability capped?
Is multi-factor authentication required for administrative accounts?
How long are customer records retained after the contract ends?
Within how long must a personal data breach be notified to the supervisory authority?
What is the company's policy on remote work from another country?
questions.note: Nothing in the corpus addresses remote work location. A system that answers this is fabricating.

questions.question: What was Acme Corporation's revenue last financial year?
questions.note: Plausible-sounding and entirely absent -- the classic case where a model answers from pretraining.

questions.question: Which third-party subprocessors does Northwind Consulting use for data hosting?
questions.note: The agreement mentions third-party licences but never names a subprocessor.
